statement.p: The equation of the line that goes through the points ( -3 ,2 ) and ( 4 ,-3 ) can be written in the form y = mx+b where

solution.p: First, we need to find the slope of the line using the formula: m = \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1} = \frac{-3-2}{4 + 3} = {-{\frac{5}{7}}}

Then substitute this value of m and the point (-3,2) to get \begin{aligned} 2 \amp = {-{\frac{5}{7}}} (-3) + b \\ 2 \amp = {{\frac{15}{7}}} + b\\ \end{aligned}
Subtracting \displaystyle{{{\frac{15}{7}}}} to both sides {-{\frac{1}{7}}} = b
